title: New York judge declines to block Kalshi from operating in the state for now
content: Judge Melissa Crane did not shut down Kalshi's operations in a hearing Monday, but did say she wanted both parties to present their full arguments in an expedited fashion.

title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
content: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

title: Bitcoin rebound already losing steam as AI trade returns with a bang
content: Nvidia jumped more than 30% and has recovered most of its losses since CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, but bitcoin is lagging as U.S. selling persists, traders said.

title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest pulls the plug on two planned crypto ETFs
content: ProShares' rival CoinDesk 20 Crypto ETF (KRYP) holds $1.81 million in assets nearly 10 months post-launch.

title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
content: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
content: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
content: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.

title: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
content: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo said competitors encouraged companies to opt out of OKXICE’s rollout, while some issuers simply wanted more time.

title: Bitcoin rebounds 17% from $55K lows as Nvidia rally sparks $500M crypto liquidations
content: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.

title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
content: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.

title: GPU Jesus Has Risen: Jensen Huang’s Nvidia Comeback Gets a Meme Parade
content: Hollywood, WWE and GPU Jesus joined the celebration after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang on Monday, while viral AI memes cast Anthropic's Dario Amodei as the unlikely villain of the comeback.

title: Solo Bitcoin Miner Scores Again, Hitting $191,000 Jackpot Against the Odds
content: The lone miner solved block 977057 through Solo CKPool, pocketing 3.13 BTC (worth about $191,000) in a lottery-like feat that normally only industrial-scale mining farms pull off.

title: Perps and Swaps: How to Trade the News on Decrypt
content: Decrypt readers can now swap tokens and trade perpetual futures from a single Money Account. Here's how The Information Exchange works.

title: Jensen Huang’s Wealth Rises $36 Billion as Nvidia Surge Burns Short Sellers for $12 Billion
content: Nvidia shares jumped more than 33% after the board reinstated Huang 11 days post-resignation, adding over $36 billion to his fortune while dealing short sellers their worst single-day loss since at least 2019.

title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is as Scarce as Bitcoin—And Bitmine Just Bought More
content: Chairman Tom Lee argued ETH’s supply has grown just 0.90% annually since mid-2025—roughly matching Bitcoin’s 0.82% and far below Solana, XRP and Cardano.

title: Bitdeer Sells All 281 Bitcoin It Mined Last Week, Holds None
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitdeer Sells All 281 Bitcoin It Mined Last Week, Holds None Bitdeer mined 281.1 BTC last week and sold all of it, leaving the miner with no bitcoin of its own as of Nov. 20 while American Bitcoin borrows against its reserve instead. This post Bitdeer Sells All 281 Bitcoin It Mined Last Week, Holds None first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Bitwise Head of Research: Did NVIDIA Just Ignite the Bitcoin Bull Market? title: Solo Bitcoin Miner Wins $191,000 Block Reward With Just 11 TH/s
content: Bitcoin Magazine Solo Bitcoin Miner Wins $191,000 Block Reward With Just 11 TH/s A solo miner with about 11.1 TH/s found Bitcoin block 977,057 through CKpool, collecting 3.1287 BTC. The CKpool developer put the odds at about 1 in 1,650 a year. This post Solo Bitcoin Miner Wins $191,000 Block Reward With Just 11 TH/s first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Nvidia Soars as Huang Returns, Lifting Stocks and Crypto Shares
content: Bitcoin Magazine Nvidia Soars as Huang Returns, Lifting Stocks and Crypto Shares Nvidia shares jumped about 35% on Monday after the board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, lifting the Nasdaq, chip stocks, bitcoin, Coinbase, Strategy and miners. This post Nvidia Soars as Huang Returns, Lifting Stocks and Crypto Shares first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Cross River Bank Launches Its First Bitcoin-Backed Loans With LendingUSA
content: Bitcoin Magazine Cross River Bank Launches Its First Bitcoin-Backed Loans With LendingUSA Cross River Bank has launched its first bitcoin-backed loans with LendingUSA, offering $10,000 to $250,000 at 30%, 50% or 70% loan-to-value.
